# `ext::hpack` — declaration reference

Generated source inventory. Linked guides own runtime and semantic contracts; a listed declaration does not establish executable behavior.

[All modules](../README.md) · [Source](../../../extended/ext/hpack.lani#L5)

Layer: `ext`. Role: module. Profile: **Source inventory**.

RFC 7541 HPACK without I/O: N-bit prefix integers (at most 2^31-1, five continuation bytes), raw and canonical-Huffman string literals with strict padding/EOS checks, the 61-entry static table, a bounded dynamic table with eviction and size updates, a Decoder with table, header-list, field-count and string limits (Limit is non-fatal and keeps the table in step; every other error is final) and an Encoder that signals the smallest and final table size and never-indexes credentials. Passes rfc 8 (Appendix C byte for byte), nghttp2 3 (both directions against libnghttp2's HPACK, 2,512 blocks) and malformed 17 (624 blocks) oracle cases.
